o: Follow the aquatic adventures of a yellow sea sponge named SpongeBob who lives in a pineapple under the sea. When SpongeBob gets together with his friends in Bikini Bottom, there's always nautical nonsense to be found!

eps.o: When SpongeBob unknowingly breaks a witch's curse, its victim insists on being cursed again.
Larry begins to emulate Patrick when he finds out about his secret super strength.
The houses on Conch Street come alive and go on an adventure to save Patrick's rock.
Sandy upgrades SpongeBob with robotic parts after he injures his patty-flipping arm.
Squidward must figure out "whodunit" after a mysterious stranger vandalizes Mrs. Puff's Boating School.
Squidward enters a gardening competition, but struggles to keep up with SpongeBob's naturally green thumb.
To get closer to the secret formula, Plankton swaps bodies with Squidward and must learn to adapt to his new lanky form.
Sandy teaches SpongeBob cowboy skills while they pan for bubbles, unaware that Mr. Krabs is trailing them in the hunt for treasure.
Squidward creates his very own comic book, which becomes a hit around Bikini Bottom.
Mr. Krabs rents out the Krusty Krab for a big blockbuster movie, thrilled by the promise of free publicity, and a famous actor shows up to portray SpongeBob in it.

eps.t: The Fry Cook and the Elves
eps.o: SpongeBob cannot shake a group of elves who want to repay him for a good deed.
A mime begins following and imitating SpongeBob, much to his annoyance.
SpongeBob goes on a desperate search after his favorite pair of underwear goes missing.

eps.t: What Ever Happened to Baby Prunes?
eps.o: Prunes shares the story of her days as a child star to explain why she despises chocolate.
At night school, SpongeBob and Patrick dive into a series of classes on wildly different subjects.
Plankton hires Bubble Bass at the Chum Bucket and realizes he can utilize him to get his hands on a Krabby Patty.
Mr. Krabs refuses to hire repairmen for the decaying Krusty Krab, insisting that duct tape and his employees can fix everything.
The Planktons and Narwhals must work together after their feuding sparks foodie success at the farmer's market.
Bikini Bottomites and Rock Bottomites battle it out in a series of silly sports.
SpongeBob and Patrick compete for a spot in Bubble Bass' nerd clique.
Sandy’s brother, Randy, starts a backyard wrestling ring to help SpongeBob and his friends work out their disagreements.
A hair suddenly sprouts on Patrick’s head that he has trouble getting rid of.
SpongeBob and Patrick crash Squidward's yoga class.
Patrick accidentally swaps voice boxes with an intimidating mobster.
Lady Upturn is invited to learn the true meaning of friendship by joining the Gal Pals.
In a ruse to distract SpongeBob from guarding the secret formula, the Chum Bucket begins offering collectible jellyfish toys
